title: Chapter 446 Fear
content:
Chapter 446 Fear

After the two great angels of the Han Empire made their move, before everyone in the world could recover from the fear and anger, the same news came from the country of Wei next to South Korea.

Feeling that the military power of the Tang Empire is getting stronger and stronger, the Wei State can hardly be stopped by ordinary soldiers at the bottom, so there are successful examples in Korea before. Together, they also wiped out the millions of Tang troops that were approaching the capital of Wei State.

In this way, following the actions of the four celestial figures, the elite troops of the Great Tang Empire of more than two million were wiped out.

And it also brought panic that swept the entire world, as well as more intense conflicts.

His own army was killed by a few shameless angels for no apparent reason, and died so unjustly and unworthily.

After more than a hundred years of conquest, the Tang Empire, whose whole country is extremely proud, naturally couldn't bear this tone.

Today's Tang Empire has undergone long-term conquests and continuous recruitment of talents. There are already five immortals in the country. The number is two more than the beginning, which can be said to be a great increase in strength.

Moreover, most of the gods in the Tang Empire were people with superb cultivation within the same level, and their overall strength was more than double that of the gods of the Han and Wei countries combined.

So Tang Empire made a move.

With Yuan Tiangang, the leader of all the sects in the country as the main general, plus two other angels who have recently taken refuge, they formed the crusade lineup this time.

Of course, there were only these three heavenly immortals who went out this time, and there were no other ordinary troops, not even a sixth-order earth immortal.

Because any existence below the level of immortals is an ant, and they are not qualified to intervene in the war between immortals.

Now, no matter how many troops are brought along, no matter how many strong men go with them, it is nothing more than adding some more ants that can be killed at will to the immortals of Han and Wei.

When the three of Yuan Tiangang came to Korea and Wei, the angels of the two countries, who had already prepared and expected, took the initiative to fight against them.

Because of the preparation, this time the four angels arranged a formation in advance, and after drawing Yuan Tiangang and others into the formation, they immediately gained a great advantage.

Afterwards, even if Yuan Tiangang had the strength to fight against two or even three within the same rank. The two angels who followed him were not mediocre, but facing the siege of the formation, they still inevitably fell into a disadvantage.

The battle was extremely tragic and lasted a very long time.

This battle lasted a total of three months from the beginning to the end. The aftermath of the three-month battle turned all the more than 500 miles around the battlefield into barren land, and all the people on it died tragically. The divine power of the eighth-rank celestial being, which is deeply testified by countless corpses, is indeed not something that mortals can provoke and peek at.

At the end of the battle, all the two immortals who came with Yuan Tiangang were killed, and three of the four immortals from Han and Wei also died, including the founding ancestors of the two countries.

The remaining one also dragged his seriously injured body to find a secret place to heal his wounds secretly after the battle, and never heard of it coming out again.

Thinking about it, he was also frightened by the brutality of this war, and never dared to intervene in worldly battles.

As the only surviving member of the Tang Empire, Yuan Tiangang himself was also seriously injured.

Surrounded by a large formation, even with Yuan Tiangang's ability to make it a tie this time, he suffered extremely serious injuries. If he could not get recuperation and treatment in time, maybe Yuan Tiangang, who survived by chance, would also fall due to his serious injuries.

After the war ended, the news spread quickly, causing another shock among the people on the mainland.

It's been a long time since an immortal was killed on the battlefield. The most recent one was Zixiao Xianzun in the Ming Dynasty a hundred years ago, beheading the Peng Demon King like Qianli Mountain Forest.

Even if a celestial being died, or even a celestial being of the Yao clan, there were still discussions in the world for several years, and the shock to people's hearts was even more unimaginable.

But now, on a Korean-Wei battlefield, five heavenly immortals died at once, and the remaining two fled with serious injuries. It is not known whether they can survive their injuries.

How can this prevent everyone from being shocked, and not make people in the world fear?

The death of an unrivaled figure like an eighth-level celestial being is certainly shocking. But the tens of millions of civilians who were killed or injured because of these people's fights made all the people at the bottom of the world feel chilling and fearful.

It's not that they are timid, it's that the destructive power of the eighth level is too strong, they can destroy tens of thousands of troops with a single move, how can this ability not make people who have not reached the eighth level feel intimidated.

It is the people of South Korea who suffer today, so if the gods of our country come to such a big battle tomorrow, will it be me who will die?

Therefore, all the low-level people in the world have issued strong appeals, asking those eighth-level powerhouses not to intervene in the battles between the world at will, and to maintain their previous detached status.

I also want to stop fighting among the major empires, lest a dynasty must come to a dead end and attract the founding ancestor of that dynasty to take action, and then there will be another catastrophe.

This idea immediately swept through the minds of all the low-level people in the world, and formed a general trend. Under this general trend, many high-level officials of the dynasty, including those eighth-level angels, were a little hard to stop, and began to consider whether to obey.

However, before these peace-seeking countries could discuss a useful charter, the Tang Empire, which had attracted the attention of the world before, released another extremely explosive news.

The remaining six countries around the Tang Empire were not dragged by the battle of the eighth rank. Seeing that the strength of the Tang Empire was greatly damaged after the first battle, and the soldiers at the bottom were severely damaged. The next one was seriously injured and couldn't go to the battlefield at all.

The celestial powerhouses of the Tang Empire lost more than half of their strength at once, and could no longer form a deterrent to the surrounding empires.

The Tang Empire, which was showing a weak state, naturally inevitably attracted the coveted eyes of the enemy.

Whether it is to take advantage of this to regain lost land, or even to take the opportunity to expand. It was still to take advantage of the weakness of the Tang Empire to hit him hard, so that the Tang Dynasty fell into a slump and was no longer able to attack neighboring countries.

In short, all the eighth-level angels from the surrounding six countries formed an alliance, and then a total of 12 angels all shot together.

First, they wiped out the elite troops of the Tang Empire with a total of more than 5 million, and then 12 people approached the capital of the Tang Empire together, intending to wipe the Tang Empire from the world in one fell swoop, and eliminate future troubles forever.

Facing such crises, the Tang Empire was truly facing the greatest danger since its founding, and if it was a little careless, it would be a catastrophe for the country to be destroyed.
